spoken: reminder for everyone using the fume hood before you start check that the sash is below the marked line and the airflow monitor is green if the alarm goes off stop what you're doing close the sash and leave the room don't try to silence it we had two incidents last month where people kept working through the alarm and it wasn't good also label every container with the contents and the date even if it's just water because last week we found an unlabeled bottle that took three days to identify
intended: Reminder for everyone using the fume hood. Before you start, check that the sash is below the marked line and the airflow monitor is green. If the alarm goes off, stop what you're doing, close the sash, and leave the room. Don't try to silence it. We had two incidents last month where people kept working through the alarm, and it wasn't good. Also, label every container with the contents and the date, even if it's just water, because last week we found an unlabeled bottle that took three days to identify.
